truth: CORE-01, CORE-02, CORE-03, CORE-04 and PLATFORM-00 are closed as construction dependencies. APP-01 is ACTIVE; DAW-00 is PRESERVED incomplete; OPS-04 is dependency-ready.

APP-01A is implemented on mergeable draft PR #40 head 36082df3f29d2fe9b1ff4b5e1f29474a001ef16f. It supplies one existing-profile runtime with exact lease ownership, explicit quit and durable Song/version reopen. Hosted exact-head execution is UNOBSERVED.

Global reselection kept APP-01 active for APP-01B because APP-01A intentionally assumes an existing profile; a fresh local install still lacked a truthful Artist-profile create/discover/select substrate beneath future UX.
APP-01B is the only active increment. ApplicationProfiles discovers only direct canonical candidates under data_root/profiles and never performs a disk-wide profile crawl.
Healthy catalog discovery opens only LineageStore, not the full Headquarters composition root, so merely asking which profiles exist cannot initialize unrelated service schemas.

A missing profiles directory is a healthy empty install. A symlink profiles root, including a dangling symlink, is a recovery issue rather than an empty-install signal. Valid-looking profile symlinks/non-directories and malformed prf_ names are also explicit issues.
Any catalog issue yields RECOVERY_REQUIRED before first-profile creation. Corrupted state can never be silently bypassed by inventing a new Artist identity beside it.
One healthy profile resolves SELECTED_EXISTING. Multiple healthy profiles require NEEDS_SELECTION until an exact existing profile ID is supplied; no recency/path heuristic guesses identity.
A truly empty healthy catalog without artist identity input returns NEEDS_CREATION. First-profile creation requires exact ProcessIdentity and ProcessProbe plus an opaque PLATFORM-00B bootstrap lease.
After acquiring the bootstrap lease APP-01B re-discovers durable truth before creating. If another valid profile appeared, that profile wins and no duplicate identity is created.

Existing bootstrap ownership is not creation permission. Foreign ALIVE and same-process ALREADY_OWNED bootstrap leases yield BOOTSTRAP_BUSY; UNKNOWN ownership fails closed as RECOVERY_REQUIRED; only verified DEAD ownership may be replaced with previous-lease evidence.

On true first creation, HeadquartersMemory.create establishes the canonical Artist profile, closes it, and the bootstrap lease must release before success. Bootstrap release failure becomes RECOVERY_REQUIRED rather than pretending creation is cleanly finished.

The current n0te2/profiles.py Git blob after pre-test red-team repairs is a3462e4cdcc718694fd2b453aff8d7e6fa01f71b. Repository APP-01B regressions are authored but hosted exact-head execution has not yet been observed.
APP-01B contains no profile delete/merge/rename, account/auth, cloud/sync, onboarding UI, installer/update/rollback, DAW, AUDIO or OPS implementation.
Windows and Linux remain peer consumer platforms with macOS. APP lifecycle semantics may not become macOS-first by developer-machine chronology.
